pr_title: refactor(compiler-cli): error on cyclic imports in partial compilation
pr_body:
Our approach for handling cyclic imports results in code that is
not easy to tree-shake, so it is not suitable for publishing in a
library.

When compiling in partial compilation mode, we are targeting
such library publication, so we now create a fatal diagnostic
error instead of trying to handle the cyclic import situation.

Closes #40678

review_comments: Can we do `unshift` here to avoid `reverse` at the end?

We could, but I did it this way because it seemed like it would be more efficient.

Unshifting means that it has to move all the current items along on each iteration, whereas as pushing just extends the array and the reverse only touches all the items once at the end. I reckon that reversing an array is super quick, since it can be done in-place.
Agree, the current implementation is more efficient.
